networkAccess.reasoning: Creates Azure DevOps work items from a selected frame, attaching the frame thumbnail and a deep link back to the node. Optional AI Draft (off by default) sends the frame name, native Figma annotations, and visible text-layer copy — no image content — to the user's chosen LLM provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI on the user's own tenant) using their own API key stored locally. No third-party servers, no telemetry.
